title: Software QA Developer Intern - 2027
description:
NVIDIA is the world leader in AI and GPU computing. We are passionate about four markets: Gaming, Automotive, Enterprise Graphics, networking, and HPC/Cloud Datacenters; in addition to our traditional OEM business. We are well positioned as the ‘AI Computing Company’, and our GPUs are the brains powering modern Deep Learning software frameworks, accelerated analytics, big data, modern data centers, smart cities, and driving autonomous vehicles. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us. If you're talented, bright driven, and if working with smart technical people across countries sounds interesting, this job is for you.
What you’ll be doing:
Design test automations for our software distributions that include desktop/mobile/embedded OS, SDK, Developer Tools and deep learning packages.
Develop tools for intelligent test report analysis.
Develop tools for intelligent test planning with code coverage.
Research and develop AI tools to understand image or videos for GUI automation.
What we need to see:
Strong knowledge on Linux Operating systems
Proven ability in scripting languages.
2nd year or 3rd year in a master program of engineering discipline.
Available to work full time for 1 year internship.
Ways to stand out from the crowd:
Understand native programming (C/C++)
Skills in cloud computing (docker, Kubernetes)
Experiences in developing front end application
Knowledge in AI and deep learning.
NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people on the planet working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!
